q: 你们先去教室___，我马上就来。
zh: 你们先去教室吧，我马上就来。
py: nǐ men xiān qù jiào shì ba wǒ mǎ shàng jiù lái
en: You go to the classroom first; I'll be right there.
why: 吧 softens the instruction. 吗 would ask whether they are going, and the speaker is telling them what to do.

q: 太晚了，我们回家___。
zh: 太晚了，我们回家吧。
py: tài wǎn le wǒ men huí jiā ba
en: It's too late; let's go home.
why: 'Let's...' is a suggestion, which is 吧. 吗 would ask 'Are we going home?', and 呢 and 的 make no proposal.

task: Reassure the listener: he will definitely come.
zh: 他明天一定会来的。
py: tā míng tiān yī dìng huì lái de
en: He will definitely come tomorrow.
why: 一定会...的 turns a plain prediction into a firm assurance; 了 would announce a change instead.

s: 他还是孩子嘛，别太严格。
zh: 他还是孩子嘛，别太严格。
py: tā hái shi hái zi ma bié tài yán gé
en: He's still a child, after all; don't be too strict.
why: 嘛 states the obvious and does not ask. It is a different word from 吗, though they sound the same.

s_py: nǐ xiān zuò xià ma wǒ qù ná shuǐ
zh: 你先坐下吧，我去拿水。
py: nǐ xiān zuò xià ba wǒ qù ná shuǐ
en: Sit down first; I'll go and get some water.
why: A soft instruction takes 吧. 吗 only forms a question, and the sentence is not asking anything.

zh: 你不会是生气了吧？
py: nǐ bù huì shì shēng qì le ba
en: You're not angry, are you?
why: 不会是...吧 is a fixed way to voice a worried guess while hoping it is not so. 了 before 吧 is correct because it says you have become angry, a new state.

q: 我才不去___！那个会太无聊了。
zh: 我才不去呢！那个会太无聊了。
py: wǒ cái bù qù ne nà ge huì tài wú liáo le
en: I'm certainly not going! That meeting is too boring.
why: 才不...呢 is the pattern for a firm refusal. 吗 would turn it into a question and 吧 would soften it into a vague guess.

zh: 这个办公室多安静啊！
py: zhè ge bàn gōng shì duō ān jìng a
en: How quiet this office is!
why: The exclamation 多 + adjective ends with 啊, which carries the feeling.

s_py: nǐ de xīn jiā duō piào liang ma
zh: 你的新家多漂亮啊！
py: nǐ de xīn jiā duō piào liang a
en: How beautiful your new home is!
why: 多 + adjective is an exclamation, which takes 啊. 吗 makes a yes/no question and cannot end an exclamation.

q: 我不知道你的安排，你明天要上班___？
zh: 我不知道你的安排，你明天要上班吗？
py: wǒ bù zhī dào nǐ de ān pái nǐ míng tiān yào shàng bān ma
en: I don't know your schedule. Do you have to work tomorrow?
why: The speaker has no guess, so this is a neutral yes/no question: 吗. 吧 would mean 'you have to work tomorrow, right?', which contradicts 我不知道.

q: 妈妈正在做饭___，你别进厨房。
zh: 妈妈正在做饭呢，你别进厨房。
py: mā ma zhèng zài zuò fàn ne nǐ bié jìn chú fáng
en: Mum is cooking right now; don't go into the kitchen.
why: 正在 + verb + 呢 describes what is going on at this moment. 了 would report that cooking has started or finished, and 吗 or 吧 do not state a fact.

q: 请问，你们学校有图书馆___？
zh: 请问，你们学校有图书馆吗？
py: qǐng wèn nǐ men xué xiào yǒu tú shū guǎn ma
en: Excuse me, does your school have a library?
why: A plain statement becomes a neutral yes/no question with 吗 at the end. 呢 needs a bare noun or an existing question, and 的 does not ask anything.

q: 你放心，我保证不会把这件事告诉别人___。
zh: 你放心，我保证不会把这件事告诉别人的。
py: nǐ fàng xīn wǒ bǎo zhèng bù huì bǎ zhè jiàn shì gào su bié rén de
en: Rest assured, I promise I won't tell anyone about this.
why: 保证 + 不会...的 is a firm promise. 了 does not fit a future promise, and 吧 would make the promise tentative.

s_py: wǒ shì zhōng guó rén nǐ ma
zh: 我是中国人，你呢？
py: wǒ shì zhōng guó rén nǐ ne
en: I'm Chinese. And you?
why: 'And you?' is bare pronoun + 呢. 吗 needs a full statement, so 你吗 cannot bounce the question back.

q: 老师说这次考试的成绩还没公布___，大家先不要着急。
zh: 老师说这次考试的成绩还没公布呢，大家先不要着急。
py: lǎo shī shuō zhè cì kǎo shì de chéng jì hái méi gōng bù ne dà jiā xiān bù yào zháo jí
en: The teacher said the exam results haven't been announced yet, so everyone shouldn't worry for now.
why: 还没公布 describes a situation that has not changed, so 呢 fits and 了 does not. 吗 would ask and the sentence is a report.

q: 他还是个孩子___，别生气。
zh: 他还是个孩子嘛，别生气。
py: tā hái shi ge hái zi ma bié shēng qì
en: He's still a child, after all; don't be angry.
why: 嘛 says 'obviously, after all' and asks nothing. 吗 would make it 'Is he still a child?', which contradicts the plea that follows.

q: 你先坐___，我去倒茶。
zh: 你先坐吧，我去倒茶。
py: nǐ xiān zuò ba wǒ qù dào chá
en: Have a seat first; I'll go and pour some tea.
why: 吧 softens an instruction into a polite invitation. 吗 would ask whether the person sits, and 呢 or 了 do not invite.

q: 你唱得多好___！大家都喜欢听。
zh: 你唱得多好啊！大家都喜欢听。
py: nǐ chàng de duō hǎo a dà jiā dōu xǐ huan tīng
en: How well you sing! Everyone loves to listen.
why: The exclamation 多好 takes 啊 for warmth. 吗 would ask whether the singing is good, which does not fit the following praise.

s: 现在才六点呢，天还没亮。
zh: 现在才六点呢，天还没亮。
py: xiàn zài cái liù diǎn ne tiān hái méi liàng
en: It's only six o'clock; it isn't light yet.
why: 才...呢 marks 'only'. Ending with 呢 rather than 了 is right because nothing has changed yet.

zh: 好吧，那我明天再来。
py: hǎo ba nà wǒ míng tiān zài lái
en: All right then, I'll come again tomorrow.
why: 好吧 is a reluctant 'all right then'. The particle is 吧, not 吗, because the speaker is giving in rather than asking.

q: 这次旅行能认识这么多新朋友，我真高兴___！
zh: 这次旅行能认识这么多新朋友，我真高兴啊！
py: zhè cì lǚ xíng néng rèn shi zhè me duō xīn péng you wǒ zhēn gāo xìng a
en: I'm so happy to have met so many new friends on this trip!
why: 真高兴 is an exclamation of feeling, so 啊. 吗 would ask whether the speaker is happy, and 吧 would hedge it.

q: 你们的会议室在几楼___？
zh: 你们的会议室在几楼？
py: nǐ men de huì yì shì zài jǐ lóu
en: Which floor is your meeting room on?
why: 几楼 is a question word, so the sentence is already a question and takes no 吗. 吗 is only added to a statement.

q: 你想看就看___，我不管。
zh: 你想看就看呗，我不管。
py: nǐ xiǎng kàn jiù kàn bei wǒ bù guǎn
en: If you want to watch it, just watch it, then; I don't care.
why: ...就...呗 says 'just do it then', with a shrug, and fits 我不管. 吗 would ask a question and 呢 states an ongoing situation.

q: 你们俩应该早就认识了___？
zh: 你们俩应该早就认识了吧？
py: nǐ men liǎ yīng gāi zǎo jiù rèn shi le ba
en: You two must have known each other for ages, I take it?
why: 应该 expresses an expectation, so 吧 asks for agreement. 吗 would be a neutral question and does not fit 应该.

q: 他为什么还不来___？
zh: 他为什么还不来呢？
py: tā wèi shén me hái bù lái ne
en: Why isn't he here yet, I wonder?
why: 为什么 makes this a question, so 吗 cannot follow. 呢 softens it to 'I wonder why'; 了 would clash with 还不 (not yet).

q: 多好的老师___！大家都很喜欢他。
zh: 多好的老师啊！大家都很喜欢他。
py: duō hǎo de lǎo shī a dà jiā dōu hěn xǐ huan tā
en: What a good teacher! Everyone likes him.
why: 多 + adjective + 的 + noun + 啊 is an exclamation. 吗 would ask and 了 reports a change, neither of which fits the praise.

q: 我们班有三十个人，你们班___？
zh: 我们班有三十个人，你们班呢？
py: wǒ men bān yǒu sān shí ge rén nǐ men bān ne
en: Our class has thirty people. What about yours?
why: After a statement about one thing, noun + 呢 asks the same about another: 'and yours?'. 吗 would need a full clause such as 你们班有三十个人吗.

q: 如果你觉得这份工作太累，就换一份轻松一些的___。
zh: 如果你觉得这份工作太累，就换一份轻松一些的吧。
py: rú guǒ nǐ jué de zhè fèn gōng zuò tài lèi jiù huàn yī fèn qīng sōng yī xiē de ba
en: If you find this job too tiring, why not switch to a more relaxed one?
why: 吧 turns the advice 就换... into a gentle suggestion. 吗 would ask whether the listener will switch and 呢 states a situation.

q: 小声一点，弟弟还在睡觉___。
zh: 小声一点，弟弟还在睡觉呢。
py: xiǎo shēng yī diǎn dì di hái zài shuì jiào ne
en: Keep it down; my little brother is still sleeping.
why: 还在 + verb marks something still going on, and 呢 stresses that state. 了 would announce a new situation, and 吗 would ask.

zh: 你一定会成功的。
py: nǐ yī dìng huì chéng gōng de
en: You will surely succeed.
why: 一定会...的 is the assurance frame: the adverb before 会 and 的 closes the sentence.

q: 我已经不喝咖啡___，医生说对身体不好。
zh: 我已经不喝咖啡了，医生说对身体不好。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng bù hē kā fēi le yī shēng shuō duì shēn tǐ bù hǎo
en: I don't drink coffee any more; the doctor said it's bad for my health.
why: 已经不...了 means 'not any more'. 吗 would turn it into a question, and 呢 would say that I am still not drinking it as before.

q: 你看，他已经比我高___！
zh: 你看，他已经比我高了！
py: nǐ kàn tā yǐ jīng bǐ wǒ gāo le
en: Look, he's taller than me already!
why: 已经 ... 了 reports a new state: he was not taller before. 吗 would ask and 吧 would guess at something the speaker can see.

q: 今天天气真好___！
zh: 今天天气真好啊！
py: jīn tiān tiān qì zhēn hǎo a
en: The weather is so nice today!
why: 真 + adjective is an exclamation and 啊 adds the feeling. 吗 would turn it into a question and 吧 into a guess.

q: 只要努力学习，你一定会考上大学___。
zh: 只要努力学习，你一定会考上大学的。
py: zhǐ yào nǔ lì xué xí nǐ yī dìng huì kǎo shàng dà xué de
en: As long as you study hard, you'll surely get into university.
why: A confident promise about the future: 一定会...的. 了 would announce a change that has already happened, and 吗 would turn the reassurance into a question.

zh: 我不想去了，你们去吧。
py: wǒ bù xiǎng qù le nǐ men qù ba
en: I don't want to go any more; you go.
why: 不...了 means 'not any more', so 了 is needed. 吧 then softens the instruction to the others.

task: Say you haven't eaten yet (still the case).
zh: 我还没吃饭呢。
py: wǒ hái méi chī fàn ne
en: I haven't eaten yet.
why: 还没 + verb + 呢 means 'not yet'; 了 cannot be added because nothing has happened.

q: 春天到___，花都开了。
zh: 春天到了，花都开了。
py: chūn tiān dào le huā dōu kāi le
en: Spring has arrived; the flowers are all in bloom.
why: 春天到了 reports that a new season has begun. 呢 would say it is still on the way, and 吗 or 吧 would not report a fact.

zh: 我们一起去图书馆吧。
py: wǒ men yī qǐ qù tú shū guǎn ba
en: Let's go to the library together.
why: 吧 closes the suggestion at the end; 一起 comes before the verb 去.

q: 我不会忘记今天的会议___，你放心。
zh: 我不会忘记今天的会议的，你放心。
py: wǒ bù huì wàng jì jīn tiān de huì yì de nǐ fàng xīn
en: I won't forget today's meeting; rest assured.
why: 不会...的 is a promise with 你放心 as support. 吧 would make it a shaky guess, and 了 would announce a change.

q: 你的作业写完了就去休息___。
zh: 你的作业写完了就去休息吧。
py: nǐ de zuò yè xiě wán le jiù qù xiū xi ba
en: Once your homework is done, go and rest.
why: 吧 turns a command into a kind instruction. 吗 would ask whether the listener will rest, which is not what the speaker means.

q: 经理正在开会___，你下午再来吧。
zh: 经理正在开会呢，你下午再来吧。
py: jīng lǐ zhèng zài kāi huì ne nǐ xià wǔ zài lái ba
en: The manager is in a meeting right now; come back this afternoon.
why: 正在 marks an action in progress, and 呢 closes it as 'this is how things stand'. 了 would mean the meeting has ended or started as news.

s: 冬天到呢，我们要多穿衣服。
s_py: dōng tiān dào ne wǒ men yào duō chuān yī fu
zh: 冬天到了，我们要多穿衣服。
py: dōng tiān dào le wǒ men yào duō chuān yī fu
en: Winter has arrived; we need to wear more clothes.
why: A season arriving is a new situation, which takes 了. 呢 marks a continuing state and cannot follow 到 here.

q: 你一定是李老师___？
zh: 你一定是李老师吧？
py: nǐ yī dìng shì lǐ lǎo shī ba
en: You must be Teacher Li.
why: 一定 shows the speaker is already sure and wants a nod: 吧. 吗 asks with no opinion and clashes with 一定.

q: 别难过，这次没考好没关系，下次你一定会成功___。
zh: 别难过，这次没考好没关系，下次你一定会成功的。
py: bié nán guò zhè cì méi kǎo hǎo méi guān xi xià cì nǐ yī dìng huì chéng gōng de
en: Don't be sad; it doesn't matter that you didn't do well this time. You'll surely succeed next time.
why: The speaker comforts with certainty: 一定会...的. 了 is for things that have changed, and 吗 turns comfort into a question.

q: 时间不早了，大家先回去休息___，剩下的明天再做。
zh: 时间不早了，大家先回去休息吧，剩下的明天再做。
py: shí jiān bù zǎo le dà jiā xiān huí qù xiū xi ba shèng xià de míng tiān zài zuò
en: It's getting late; let's all go home and rest first, and do the rest tomorrow.
why: The speaker proposes ending the work for today: 吧. 吗 would ask and 呢 or 的 would only describe.

q: 老师说下周要交报告，可是资料还没找齐，我们该怎么办___？
zh: 老师说下周要交报告，可是资料还没找齐，我们该怎么办呢？
py: lǎo shī shuō xià zhōu yào jiāo bào gào kě shì zī liào hái méi zhǎo qí wǒ men gāi zěn me bàn ne
en: The teacher says the report is due next week, but we haven't even gathered the materials. So what should we do?
why: 怎么办 is a question word, so 吗 is out; 呢 gives the worried 'so what now?' tone. 吧 would make a suggestion, which a question-word question does not take.

q: 我本来想去，现在不想去___。
zh: 我本来想去，现在不想去了。
py: wǒ běn lái xiǎng qù xiàn zài bù xiǎng qù le
en: I did want to go, but I don't want to any more.
why: 本来 ... 现在不 ... 了 marks a change in wishes: 'not any more'. 吗 would ask and 吧 would turn it into a guess.

q: 你这个周末加不加班___？
zh: 你这个周末加不加班？
py: nǐ zhè ge zhōu mò jiā bù jiā bān
en: Are you working overtime this weekend or not?
why: 加不加班 is a verb-不-verb question already, so adding 吗 doubles the question. Use 吗 or A-not-A, never both.

q: 别担心，你会好___。
zh: 别担心，你会好的。
py: bié dān xīn nǐ huì hǎo de
en: Don't worry, you'll get better.
why: 会 + verb or adjective + 的 is a calm assurance about the future. 了 reports a change that has already happened.

zh: 我保证，我不会迟到的。
py: wǒ bǎo zhèng wǒ bù huì chí dào de
en: I promise I won't be late.
why: 不会...的 is the standard promise form. The final 的 is not the 是...的 pattern; it adds certainty.

q: 快来___，电影马上就要开始了！
zh: 快来啊，电影马上就要开始了！
py: kuài lái a diàn yǐng mǎ shàng jiù yào kāi shǐ le
en: Come on, hurry; the film is about to start!
why: 啊 gives friendly urgency to 快来. 吗 would ask whether the person is coming, and 呢 or 的 do not urge.

q: 天黑___，我们回家吧。
zh: 天黑了，我们回家吧。
py: tiān hēi le wǒ men huí jiā ba
en: It's gotten dark; let's go home.
why: 天黑了 reports a new situation: it was light, now it is dark. 呢 would mean it is still dark, and 吗 would ask.

q: 他一定会来___，你再等一会儿。
zh: 他一定会来的，你再等一会儿。
py: tā yī dìng huì lái de nǐ zài děng yī huì r
en: He will definitely come; wait a little longer.
why: 一定会...的 is a firm reassurance about the future. 了 would say he has already arrived or changed, and 吗 would ask a question instead of reassuring.

q: 别担心，报告我还没写完___，不过明天才交，来得及。
zh: 别担心，报告我还没写完呢，不过明天才交，来得及。
py: bié dān xīn bào gào wǒ hái méi xiě wán ne bù guò míng tiān cái jiāo lái de jí
en: Don't worry, I haven't finished the report yet, but it isn't due until tomorrow, so there's time.
why: 还没 + verb + 呢: nothing has changed yet. 了 cannot follow 还没, and 吗 would turn the reassurance into a question.

zh: 我喝茶，你呢？
py: wǒ hē chá nǐ ne
en: I'm having tea. What about you?
why: The first clause states the speaker's choice, then pronoun + 呢 bounces the question back to the listener.

q: 你刚来公司不久，大概对这里的工作还不太熟悉___？
zh: 你刚来公司不久，大概对这里的工作还不太熟悉吧？
py: nǐ gāng lái gōng sī bù jiǔ dà gài duì zhè lǐ de gōng zuò hái bù tài shú xī ba
en: You've only just joined the company, so I suppose you're not very familiar with the work here yet?
why: 大概 marks the speaker's guess and 吧 asks for confirmation. 吗 asks with no opinion, and 呢 cannot form a yes/no question.

q: 这次考试应该不难___？
zh: 这次考试应该不难吧？
py: zhè cì kǎo shì yīng gāi bù nán ba
en: The exam shouldn't have been hard, I suppose?
why: 应该 shows the speaker expects a yes, so 吧. 吗 asks with no expectation and does not combine with 应该.

q: 自从孩子上了小学，她就不再像以前那么忙___。
zh: 自从孩子上了小学，她就不再像以前那么忙了。
py: zì cóng hái zi shàng le xiǎo xué tā jiù bù zài xiàng yǐ qián nà me máng le
en: Since her child started primary school, she has no longer been as busy as before.
why: 不再...了 marks a change from before. 吗 would ask and 呢 would say she is still that busy, which contradicts 不再.

s_py: nǐ míng tiān lái bù lái shàng kè ma
zh: 你明天来不来上课？
py: nǐ míng tiān lái bù lái shàng kè
en: Are you coming to class tomorrow or not?
why: 来不来 is already the question. Use verb-不-verb or 吗, never both.

s_py: nǐ shì xīn lái de lǎo shī ba ma
zh: 你是新来的老师吧？
py: nǐ shì xīn lái de lǎo shī ba
en: You're the new teacher, right?
why: 吧 and 吗 are two different sentence-final particles and never combine. 吧 alone asks for confirmation of a guess.

q: 你的新衣服多漂亮___！
zh: 你的新衣服多漂亮啊！
py: nǐ de xīn yī fu duō piào liang a
en: How pretty your new clothes are!
why: 多 + adjective + 啊 is an exclamation. 吗 would ask, and 吧 and 了 do not express admiration.

q: 不想去就不去___，没人会勉强你。
zh: 不想去就不去呗，没人会勉强你。
py: bù xiǎng qù jiù bù qù bei méi rén huì miǎn qiǎng nǐ
en: If you don't want to go, then don't; nobody will force you.
why: 不想去就不去呗: simple, no big deal. 吗 would ask, and 呢 and 的 do not give the shrugging 'so be it'.

q: 你们大概都饿了___，我们去吃饭。
zh: 你们大概都饿了吧，我们去吃饭。
py: nǐ men dà gài dōu è le ba wǒ men qù chī fàn
en: You're probably all hungry; let's go and eat.
why: 大概 marks a guess, which 吧 carries. 吗 is a neutral question and does not combine with 大概.

q: 明天的会议经理一定会参加___？
zh: 明天的会议经理一定会参加吧？
py: míng tiān de huì yì jīng lǐ yī dìng huì cān jiā ba
en: The manager will surely attend tomorrow's meeting, won't he?
why: 一定会 shows a firm belief, and 吧 asks the listener to confirm it. 吗 asks with no opinion and does not fit 一定.

s_py: wǒ hái méi xiě wán zuò yè le
zh: 我还没写完作业呢。
py: wǒ hái méi xiě wán zuò yè ne
en: I haven't finished my homework yet.
why: 还没 means nothing has happened yet, so 了 cannot end the sentence. 呢 marks 'still the case'.

q: 现在才九点___，会议十点才开始。
zh: 现在才九点呢，会议十点才开始。
py: xiàn zài cái jiǔ diǎn ne huì yì shí diǎn cái kāi shǐ
en: It's only nine o'clock now; the meeting doesn't start until ten.
why: 才 + time + 呢 says 'only'. 了 would claim it has become nine as news, which clashes with 才, and 吗 would ask.

src_py: wǒ men míng tiān qù pá shān
zh: 我们明天去爬山吧。
py: wǒ men míng tiān qù pá shān ba
en: Let's go hiking tomorrow.
why: 吧 at the end turns the plan into a suggestion; 吗 would ask a question instead.

q: 你昨晚肯定没睡好___？
zh: 你昨晚肯定没睡好吧？
py: nǐ zuó wǎn kěn dìng méi shuì hǎo ba
en: You must not have slept well last night, right?
why: 肯定 shows the speaker is sure and wants confirmation: 吧. 吗 would ask neutrally and clashes with 肯定.

q: 我还没做作业___。
zh: 我还没做作业呢。
py: wǒ hái méi zuò zuò yè ne
en: I haven't done my homework yet.
why: 还没 says nothing has happened yet, so 了 is impossible. 呢 marks 'still the case'; 吗 would ask a question.

q: 你们公司下个月要搬到新办公室___？
zh: 你们公司下个月要搬到新办公室吗？
py: nǐ men gōng sī xià ge yuè yào bān dào xīn bàn gōng shì ma
en: Is your company moving to a new office next month?
why: A plain statement the speaker is unsure of becomes a neutral yes/no question with 吗. 嘛 sounds the same but means 'obviously' and asks nothing; 呢 and 的 do not ask yes/no questions.

zh: 你明天有时间吗？
py: nǐ míng tiān yǒu shí jiān ma
en: Do you have time tomorrow?
why: 吗 goes at the very end of a statement to ask a yes/no question; the time word may sit before or after the subject.

src_py: nǐ xǐ huan zhè ge gōng zuò
task: Turn it into a yes/no question.
zh: 你喜欢这个工作吗？
py: nǐ xǐ huan zhè ge gōng zuò ma
en: Do you like this job?
why: Adding 吗 at the end turns a statement into a yes/no question; nothing else moves.

src_py: wǒ xiǎng qù běi jīng gōng zuò
task: Say you don't want to any more.
zh: 我不想去北京工作了。
py: wǒ bù xiǎng qù běi jīng gōng zuò le
en: I don't want to go and work in Beijing any more.
why: 'Not any more' is 不 + verb + 了; without the final 了 it would only say 'I don't want to'.

zh: 他还没回来呢。
py: tā hái méi huí lái ne
en: He hasn't come back yet.
why: 还没...呢 is the standard way to say 'not yet'; 了 is never used after 还没.

q: 你说得对，好___，我听你的。
zh: 你说得对，好吧，我听你的。
py: nǐ shuō de duì hǎo ba wǒ tīng nǐ de
en: You're right. All right then, I'll do as you say.
why: 好吧 is giving in: 'all right then'. 好吗 asks 'okay?' and does not fit a speaker who is agreeing.

q: 小王___？他今天没来上课吗？
zh: 小王呢？他今天没来上课吗？
py: xiǎo wáng ne tā jīn tiān méi lái shàng kè ma
en: Where's Xiao Wang? Didn't he come to class today?
why: A bare name + 呢 asks 'where is...?' when nothing was said before. 吗 needs a full statement, and 了 or 的 do not ask.

s: 你不是说今天不上班吗？
zh: 你不是说今天不上班吗？
py: nǐ bù shì shuō jīn tiān bù shàng bān ma
en: Didn't you say you weren't working today?
why: 吗 can follow a negative statement to ask for confirmation. The sentence has no question word, A-not-A or 还是, so 吗 is correct.

zh: 他已经不是小孩子了。
py: tā yǐ jīng bù shì xiǎo hái zi le
en: He's no longer a little kid.
why: 已经不是...了 says 'no longer'. Dropping 了 would leave the change of state unmarked.

q: 你要是觉得办公室太吵，就戴上耳机___，没什么大不了的。
zh: 你要是觉得办公室太吵，就戴上耳机呗，没什么大不了的。
py: nǐ yào shi jué de bàn gōng shì tài chǎo jiù dài shàng ěr jī bei méi shén me dà bù liǎo de
en: If you find the office too noisy, just put on headphones; it's no big deal.
why: 要是...就...呗 offers the simple fix, and 没什么大不了 matches the casual tone. 吗 would ask a question, and 呢 is not a solution.

s_py: nǐ de xué xiào zài nǎ r ma
zh: 你的学校在哪儿？
py: nǐ de xué xiào zài nǎ r
en: Where is your school?
why: 哪儿 already makes this a question, so 吗 cannot be added. 吗 is only for turning a statement into a yes/no question.

s: 放心，他明天一定会准时到了。
s_py: fàng xīn tā míng tiān yī dìng huì zhǔn shí dào le
zh: 放心，他明天一定会准时到的。
py: fàng xīn tā míng tiān yī dìng huì zhǔn shí dào de
en: Rest assured, he'll definitely arrive on time tomorrow.
why: Assurance about the future is 一定会...的. 了 announces a change and cannot follow 一定会 about tomorrow.

q: 快复习___，下午还要考试。
zh: 快复习吧，下午还要考试。
py: kuài fù xí ba xià wǔ hái yào kǎo shì
en: Hurry up and revise; there's an exam this afternoon.
why: 吧 softens the urging 快复习 so it is advice, not an order. 吗 would ask a question and 呢 would describe an ongoing state.

q: 我学中文，你___？
zh: 我学中文，你呢？
py: wǒ xué zhōng wén nǐ ne
en: I'm learning Chinese. What about you?
why: 'And you?' bounces the topic back with a bare pronoun + 呢. 吗 needs a complete statement before it.

q: 我早就跟你说过这个方法不行___，你怎么还不信？
zh: 我早就跟你说过这个方法不行嘛，你怎么还不信？
py: wǒ zǎo jiù gēn nǐ shuō guo zhè ge fāng fǎ bù xíng ma nǐ zěn me hái bù xìn
en: I told you long ago this method wouldn't work, so why won't you believe me?
why: The speaker is pointing out something that should be obvious: 嘛. 吗 would ask whether it works, and the next clause shows the speaker is complaining.

q: 这是我的书___，你拿错了！
zh: 这是我的书嘛，你拿错了！
py: zhè shì wǒ de shū ma nǐ ná cuò le
en: This is my book, obviously; you took the wrong one!
why: 嘛 states the obvious: 'it's my book, can't you see?'. 吗 would ask whether it is my book, which does not fit the complaint.

q: 我们怎么回家___？
zh: 我们怎么回家呢？
py: wǒ men zěn me huí jiā ne
en: So how shall we get home?
why: 怎么 already makes this a question, so 吗 is impossible; 呢 only softens it into 'so how...?'.

q: 你想坐地铁还是想打车___？
zh: 你想坐地铁还是想打车？
py: nǐ xiǎng zuò dì tiě hái shi xiǎng dǎ chē
en: Do you want to take the subway or a taxi?
why: 还是 asks the listener to choose, so the sentence is already a question and 吗 cannot be added.

q: 这个问题很难，我们明天再讨论___。
zh: 这个问题很难，我们明天再讨论吧。
py: zhè ge wèn tí hěn nán wǒ men míng tiān zài tǎo lùn ba
en: This question is hard; let's discuss it tomorrow.
why: 再 + verb + 吧 proposes doing it later. 吗 would ask a question, and 了 cannot follow a future 明天再.

q: 我弟弟高中毕业了，现在是大学生___。
zh: 我弟弟高中毕业了，现在是大学生了。
py: wǒ dì di gāo zhōng bì yè le xiàn zài shì dà xué shēng le
en: My younger brother has finished high school; now he's a university student.
why: 现在是...了 marks a new status after graduating. 吗 would ask, and 吧 would guess at a fact the speaker already knows.

q: 这个字你认识___？
zh: 这个字你认识吗？
py: zhè ge zì nǐ rèn shi ma
en: Do you know this character?
why: A statement with no question word turns into a yes/no question with 吗. 呢 only follows a bare noun or an existing question.

zh: 我们明天几点见面呢？
py: wǒ men míng tiān jǐ diǎn jiàn miàn ne
en: So what time shall we meet tomorrow?
why: 呢 can follow a question-word question to make it sound thoughtful. It is correct here because 吗 is not allowed after 几点.

q: 你们的教室真大___！我们学校的小多了。
zh: 你们的教室真大啊！我们学校的小多了。
py: nǐ men de jiào shì zhēn dà a wǒ men xué xiào de xiǎo duō le
en: Your classroom is so big! The ones at our school are much smaller.
why: 真 + adjective is an exclamation, so 啊 adds the feeling. 吗 would ask whether it is big and the following comparison shows the speaker already knows.

q: 你到底去不去___？
zh: 你到底去不去呢？
py: nǐ dào dǐ qù bù qù ne
en: So are you going or not?
why: 去不去 is already the question, so 吗 cannot be added. 呢 adds a thoughtful or impatient tone to an A-not-A question.

q: 天气越来越冷___，你该多穿一件衣服。
zh: 天气越来越冷了，你该多穿一件衣服。
py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè lěng le nǐ gāi duō chuān yī jiàn yī fu
en: It's getting colder; you should put on another layer.
why: 越来越 + adjective ends with 了 because things are changing. 呢 would say it is cold now and nothing more, and 吗 would ask.

q: 我的书包___？我找不到了。
zh: 我的书包呢？我找不到了。
py: wǒ de shū bāo ne wǒ zhǎo bù dào le
en: Where's my school bag? I can't find it.
why: Noun + 呢 asks where something is. 吗 needs a full statement, and 吧 or 了 do not ask for a location.

q: 你怎么天天不高兴？你不喜欢这份工作___？
zh: 你怎么天天不高兴？你不喜欢这份工作吗？
py: nǐ zěn me tiān tiān bù gāo xìng nǐ bù xǐ huan zhè fèn gōng zuò ma
en: Why are you unhappy every day? Don't you like this job?
why: 吗 can follow a negative statement to ask whether it is true. 嘛 would say 'obviously you don't like it', and 呢 cannot make a statement into a question.

s: 不想吃就别吃呗，没人逼你。
zh: 不想吃就别吃呗，没人逼你。
py: bù xiǎng chī jiù bié chī bei méi rén bī nǐ
en: If you don't want to eat it, then don't; nobody's forcing you.
why: 呗 closes a 就 sentence with a shrug: 'then just don't'. It is casual but correct.

q: 这么简单的题，你当然会做___。
zh: 这么简单的题，你当然会做嘛。
py: zhè me jiǎn dān de tí nǐ dāng rán huì zuò ma
en: Such an easy problem, of course you can do it, come on.
why: 当然 signals the obvious, so 嘛. 吗 would ask whether you can, and 吧 would make it a tentative guess.

q: 你看，外面下着大雪___，今天别出去了。
zh: 你看，外面下着大雪呢，今天别出去了。
py: nǐ kàn wài miàn xià zhe dà xuě ne jīn tiān bié chū qù le
en: Look, it's snowing heavily outside; don't go out today.
why: 着 shows the snow is still falling and 呢 stresses that state. 了 would say it has just started, and 吗 would ask a question the speaker is not asking.

q: 这么晚了，他今天大概不会来参加聚会___。
zh: 这么晚了，他今天大概不会来参加聚会吧。
py: zhè me wǎn le tā jīn tiān dà gài bù huì lái cān jiā jù huì ba
en: It's so late; he probably won't come to the party today.
why: 大概 + 吧 is a probable guess. 吗 would ask a question, and 啊 would add feeling without making it tentative.
